claims.label: O'Neill's on-camera assessment that Charlie's shirt did not move as expected from a bullet impact
claims.claim: Robert O'Neill publicly stated that the shirt movement on the published footage of Charlie Kirk did not match the behavior he has observed in shootings he has personally conducted.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited Newsmax segment and any forensic analysis comparing the published footage to known ballistic wound kinematics.

claims.label: General Holt's rejection of the "spine impact" ballistics sub-narrative
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brigadier General Blaine Holt says he rejects the explanation that the bullet struck Charlie Kirk's spine and agrees with Robert O'Neill's broader critique.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the official forensic pathology report and compare it against the spine-impact narrative as relayed by federal officials.

claims.label: Governor Cox stated that the assassin changed clothes on the rooftop
claims.claim: At the September 12, 2025 FBI briefing, Utah Governor Spencer Cox stated that the suspect was first seen in one outfit, changed clothing on the rooftop, then changed back before being apprehended.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the official briefing transcript or unedited video and any follow-up statements addressing or retracting the rooftop clothing claim.

claims.label: Host Says Kash Patel and Beau Mason Did Not Intervene During Governor Cox's Clothing Statement
claims.claim: The host says neither Kash Patel nor Beau Mason interrupted or corrected Governor Cox during his statement about rooftop clothing changes at the September 12, 2025 briefing.
claims.investigative_direction: Inspect full uncut briefing video for any clarifying remarks made by either official before or after the exchange.

claims.label: Dan Bongino described the rooftop footage as "very grainy"
claims.claim: On September 15, 2025, FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino told Megyn Kelly that the rooftop video was "very grainy" and said the FBI lab has excellent tools and had been handling it for days.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the publicly released footage metadata against Bongino's "grainy" characterization and review any subsequent enhanced-release footage for consistency.

claims.label: Host Says Sgt. Jennifer Faumuina Appeared on Netflix's Worst Roommate Ever Referencing JTTF Work
claims.claim: The host says Jennifer Faumuina appeared on Season 2 Episode 1 of Netflix's *Worst Roommate Ever*, and in a clip the host plays, Faumuina says she had been with the Utah State Bureau of Investigation for 8 years and was assigned full-time to the FBI's Joint Terrorism Task Force.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the Netflix episode metadata, Faumuina's on-screen identification, and the period of her JTTF assignment against official FBI or Utah SBI records.

claims.label: Host Says Jennifer Faumuina Played Basketball at a Hawaii Private School in 2003
claims.claim: The host says her team found Jennifer Faumuina playing basketball at a private school in Hawaii in 2003.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific school and roster, and cross-reference yearbook or athletics records.

claims.label: Host Says Jennifer Faumuina Graduated from Weber State University in 2008
claims.claim: The host says Jennifer Faumuina studied criminal justice at Weber State University and graduated in 2008.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against Weber State graduation records or alumni listings.

claims.label: Jennifer Faumuina completed Utah DPS post-training on May 20, 2013
claims.claim: Per the training photo the host shows, Jennifer Faumuina apparently appears in a Utah Department of Public Safety post-training session dated May 20, 2013, alongside Beau Mason.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through DPS academy records and class photographs.

claims.label: Jennifer Faumuina volunteered as a Utah trooper for crowd control at the 2016 RNC in Ohio
claims.claim: The host says a 2016 article shows Jennifer Faumuina among the volunteer troopers providing crowd control at the Republican National Convention in Ohio.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the original article, deployment list, and credentialing records.

claims.label: Host Says Jennifer Faumuina Appears in Utah DPS Paid Records Beginning in 2018
claims.claim: The host says public salary records show Jennifer Faumuina as a paid officer with the Utah Department of Public Safety from 2018 onward, and none list her as paid before then.
claims.investigative_direction: Request Utah state salary records to verify employment dates and rank progression.

claims.label: Faumuina and Beau Mason Photographed Together on May 20, 2013
claims.claim: Per the training photo the host shows, Jennifer Faumuina and Beau Mason apparently appear together in a May 20, 2013 Utah DPS post-training session.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the photograph and underlying academy/class record.

claims.label: Host Says Faumuina and Beau Mason Were Photographed Together at Her 2023 Sergeant Swearing-In
claims.claim: The host says she shows a photograph in which Jennifer Faumuina and Beau Mason appear together in 2023 when Faumuina was sworn in as a sergeant.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the date and ceremony through Utah DPS press releases.

claims.label: Host Says Beau Mason Was Appointed Utah DPS Commissioner on June 19, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Beau "Bo" Mason was appointed Commissioner of the Utah Department of Public Safety on June 19, 2025 by Governor Cox.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify appointment through the official Utah governor's office announcement or Senate confirmation record.

claims.label: Host Says Andrew Zenger Was Appointed Timpanogos Hospital CEO on August 18, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Zenger was appointed CEO of Timpanogos Hospital on August 18, 2025, just a couple of weeks before the assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via hospital press releases and board minutes.

claims.label: Host Says Judge Tony Graf Was Appointed in May 2025
claims.claim: The host says Judge Tony Graf received a judicial appointment in May 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the appointment date, court, and appointing authority.

claims.label: Host Says Robert Bohls Assumed Leadership of FBI Salt Lake City on September 2, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Special Agent Robert Bohls took command of the FBI Salt Lake City Field Office on September 2, 2025 – eight days before the assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via FBI press releases and internal personnel announcements.

claims.label: Robert Bohls began his career at the Provo Police Department in the early 2000s
claims.claim: A 2004 article identifies Robert Bohls as having served with the Provo Police Department before joining the military and later the FBI.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Provo PD rosters and 2004 article content.

claims.label: Misiona Faumuina died in 1995 in Hawaii from injuries sustained in a gang-related beating
claims.claim: The host says Sgt. Jennifer Faumuina's uncle, Misiona Faumuina, died in 1995 in Hawaii after being beaten as part of a reported gang initiation ritual; his brother Sapena Faumuina was publicly vocal in the press.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Honolulu-area news archives and Hawaii court records for the criminal case.

claims.label: Misiona Faumuina was characterized in 1995 press coverage as a devout Mormon
claims.claim: Per 1995 press coverage the host shows, Misiona Faumuina was described as a devout Mormon who attended church in Waipahu every Sunday, in the Maquilo Ward where the family lived, with his brother Sapena noting he was preparing for a mission.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve original newspaper articles and any LDS Church ward records.

claims.label: Sid Rosen headed the "Adult Friends for Youth" organization
claims.claim: A 1995 article names Sid Rosen as the head of "Adult Friends for Youth," an organization referenced in coverage of Misiona Faumuina's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the organization and Rosen's role through Hawaii nonprofit filings.

claims.label: Frank Turek characterizes the CPR/Harpole divergence as emphasis rather than contradiction
claims.claim: Frank Turek stated on a podcast that Brian Harpole's 'no CPR' account and his own account of attempting CPR for 20-30 seconds at the end of the ride are not contradictory but rather emphasize different details.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited podcast audio and any hospital records documenting arrival time, condition, and treatment.

claims.label: Blake Neff revised his hotel-location statement from Orem to Salt Lake City
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff initially said he spent the night in Orem, UT, then revised the statement to Salt Lake City, where she says the Turning Point USA team stayed.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare both statements against travel itineraries, expense reports, and credit card records.

claims.label: Blake Neff could not name the Salt Lake City hotel where the Turning Point team stayed
claims.claim: Blake Neff stated on the record that he did not remember the name of the hotel in Salt Lake City where the Turning Point USA team stayed on the night of September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with travel booking records, expense reports, and any hotel worker testimony.

claims.label: Lt. Col. Kolvet Posts That He Never Worked at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: Lt. Col. Kolvet posted on X that he is Andrew Kolvet's only brother, that he never worked at Fort Huachuca, and that he visited the installation once for a 3-day MP unit training event.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post's text and timestamps; check Andrew Kolvet's residence and any prior Fort Huachuca references.

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu and Ben-Gvir Openly Rooted for Argentina Against Spain
claims.claim: The host says Itamar Ben-Gvir and Benjamin Netanyahu explicitly came out and said they were rooting for Argentina against Spain, and that this was not helpful to that team.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the public statements or posts by Ben-Gvir and Netanyahu about the match and confirm which team they backed.
claims.transcript_snippet: having them explicitly come out and say that they were rooting uh for that team to win was not helpful.

claims.label: Host Says Lutnick and Trump Got Involved With the US Team
claims.claim: The host says that Howard Lutnick and President Trump involved themselves in the US team's run, which made her root against the US.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify what involvement by Lutnick and Trump with the team the host means and find contemporaneous coverage.
claims.transcript_snippet: But as soon as the corrupt Howard Lutnick and President Trump got involved and 9/11 crew getting back together, they stuck their noses in it.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet's Big Brother, a Lieutenant Colonel, Defended Him on X This Weekend
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet's big brother, a lieutenant colonel in the military, defended Andrew on X over the weekend before this episode.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the brother's X post and its date, and confirm his rank and identity against Army records or earlier public statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Kolvet's big brother, Lieutenant Colonel in the military, came to Andrew's defense on X this weekend.

claims.label: O'Neill Says Nobody Gave Kirk First Aid and Staff Were Pulling SIM Cards From Cameras
claims.claim: Robert O'Neill says on Newsmax that nobody started first aid on Charlie Kirk and that people were more concerned with getting SIM cards out of cameras, removing cameras and getting Kirk off the X.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the UVU and bystander video of the first minute after the shot, and ask O'Neill for his source on the SIM card and camera removal.
claims.transcript_snippet: The just the fact that no one started doing first aid to Charlie Kirk, they were more concerned about getting SIM cards out of cameras, removing cameras, and then getting him off the X somehow.

claims.label: O'Neill Says He Was Told the Scene Was Paved Over a Couple Days Later
claims.claim: Robert O'Neill says he has been told that the crime scene was paved over a couple of days after the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU or contractor records of when the paving at the scene was done.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've been told they paved it over a couple days later

claims.label: O'Neill Says Erika's Quick Forgiveness of the Alleged Shooter Implies It Was Him
claims.claim: Robert O'Neill says Erika Kirk was very quick to forgive the alleged shooter, which he says technically concedes that it was him, while she cannot forgive Candace Owens for asking questions.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Erika Kirk's memorial remarks about forgiving the accused and the dates she criticized the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: she's really quick to forgive the alleged shooter, which technically says that was him cuz I forgive him

claims.label: General Holt Says Something Exploded on Kirk
claims.claim: Air Force Brigadier General Blaine Holt says on Newsmax that he is with Robert O'Neill and that something exploded on Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Holt what he saw that supports an explosion and compare with the autopsy and wound descriptions.
claims.transcript_snippet: Absolutely not. I I I I'm with Rob. Something exploded on him.

claims.label: Holt Says the Justice Department Solved the Case in About Eight Hot Seconds
claims.claim: General Holt says the explanation put out by the Justice Department that day was garbage and that they seemingly solved the case in about eight seconds, and that millions of veterans know better.
claims.investigative_direction: Pin down the time between the shooting and the first DOJ or FBI public attribution of the suspect.
claims.transcript_snippet: the garbage that was foisted upon us from the Justice Department that day where they seemingly solved the case in about eight hot seconds.

claims.label: Holt Says a Kid Who Never Killed Would Not Be Sent Onto a Roof With a .30-06
claims.claim: General Holt says you are not going to take a .30-06 with a kid who has never killed anybody up onto a roof and have him take his first life and do all the things O'Neill described.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Robinson's firearms and hunting history in the charging documents.
claims.transcript_snippet: You're not going to take a.30-06 with a kid who's never killed anybody up onto a roof.

claims.label: Host Says Cox Described the Clothing Change After Robinson Was Arrested and His Texts Seized
claims.claim: The host says Governor Cox's statement about the rooftop clothing change came after Tyler Robinson had been arrested, his text messages seized and campus footage presumably reviewed.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the dates of Robinson's arrest and the text message seizure with the September 12 briefing.
claims.transcript_snippet: this is after they arrested Tyler Robinson, seized the text messages, had the ability to review them, review the footage everywhere on campus, presumably.

claims.label: Host Says the Change Cox Described Was From a Maroon Shirt to a Long-Sleeve Shirt With an American Flag
claims.claim: The host says the clothing change described by Governor Cox was from a maroon shirt into a long-sleeve shirt with an American flag, performed on the rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the charging documents and photos for the two garments Cox meant.
claims.transcript_snippet: what would be the point of changing from a maroon shirt into a long-sleeve shirt with an American flag on a rooftop?

claims.label: Host Says She Previously Got a Time Zone Wrong by Using a Website That Gave UTC
claims.claim: The host says she once got a time zone calculation wrong after daylight saving time because a website she thought gave local time gave UTC, and influencers then called her an idiot.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the host's original post and the later correction to see which time was affected.
claims.transcript_snippet: Let me get a time zone calculation incorrect, right? After daylight saving time, let me use a website and think that it's giving me local time and share local time as I did, and then turns out it's not local time, it's UTC.

claims.label: Host Says O'Neill Said the Screwdriver Could Not Take the Gun Apart
claims.claim: The host says that in the part of his interview she did not play, Robert O'Neill said this is not the right screwdriver to take apart the gun the authorities say was taken apart.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Newsmax interview and compare with the evidence photo of the screwdriver and the rifle's fasteners.
claims.transcript_snippet: He he says, "This isn't even the right screwdriver to take apart the gun that they're telling you that he took apart.

claims.label: Host Says the Rooftop Man Neither Assembled nor Disassembled His Rifle on Losee
claims.claim: The host says that, as is now known, the rooftop man neither assembled nor disassembled his rifle on the Losee Center roof.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the investigative record on where and when the rifle was assembled.
claims.transcript_snippet: the rooftop man neither assembled or disassembled his rifle on Losee.

claims.label: Host Speculates the Screwdriver Was Planted Because It Carried Robinson's DNA
claims.claim: The host speculates that officials may have planted the screwdriver, and then had to make it fit the story, because it carried Tyler Robinson's DNA and was one of the only things tying him to the rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI DNA report on the screwdriver and its chain of custody. (Speculation framed as a question by the host.)
claims.transcript_snippet: Did they already plant the evidence that and had to just sort of make it work after that because it had Tyler Robinson's DNA on it?
